notes.title: Update 1.9.0 – Major Economy Upgrades, 7 Days to Die 2.0, and UI Improvements
notes.content: [list][*][p]Updated the "7 Days To Die" mod to support game version 2.0.[/p][/*][*][p]The Economy settings now let you set how many points users receive for gifts in TikTok.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now view all users and their points in the Economy settings. (Future updates will allow you to manage user points.)[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the settings screen for a more compact layout; widgets have been moved to a separate section.[/p][/*][*][p]The main chat page was rewritten for better performance and stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added short descriptions to widgets for easier understanding.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.8.6 – German Language, 7 Days to Die, and More
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added full German language support for the app and chat voiceover.[/p][/*][*][p]Integrated with "7 Days To Die" game \[BETA].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved spam filter accuracy.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to display the chat widget on the left or right side of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI bug causing extra padding for Twitch messages.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more explanatory texts to widgets for better usability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various UI issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cloud data saving errors.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.8.0 – Disappearing Messages & 7 Days To Die Integration
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added "Temporary Messages" for the chat widget. You can now enable this feature and set how long messages will stay on screen before disappearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Created a mod for "7 Days To Die" that allows you to use Economy points to spawn monsters, give supplies, and perform other in-game actions. \[IN DEV][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various UI bugs[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.7.9 – Feature Upgrades, TikTok & Twitch Channel Points, and New Economy
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] issues with [b]TikTok connection[/b] and [b]message handling[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the "[b]Top Likers (TikTok)[/b]" widget: now you can configure the [b]number of users[/b], [b]vertical/horizontal layout[/b], and [b]left/right alignment[/b]. The app also suggests the [b]recommended[/b] widget [b]size[/b] based on your settings. [b]Added[/b] the ability to [b]send test data[/b] to preview the widget.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]support[/b] for "[url="https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/channel-points-guide?language=en_US#managing"]Twitch Channel Points[/url]"! [b]Find[/b] it in "[b]Settings → Actions[/b]" Set up rewards on [b]Twitch[/b] and get a one-minute [b]notification[/b] when viewers use them. You can also set up a widget to [b]display[/b] Channel Points activity [b]across all platforms[/b]. \[BETA][/p][/*][*][p]Introduced the new "[b]Economy[/b]" section \[BETA]. Now users on all platforms [b]can earn points[/b], which can [b][u]later[/u][/b] be [b]spent on streamer challenges[/b], sounds, actions, and more. For now, users can start collecting points, and there's a leaderboard [b]widget[/b] for top point earners.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summarization[/b] now allows you to specify the [b]AI’s name[/b] and the [b]streamer’s name[/b], providing [b]better context [/b]— so the AI knows when chat refers to the streamer or to itself, and [b]can even react[/b] to chat messages.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new "[b]characters[/b]" for [b]summarization[/b] \[TESTS].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved[/b] summarization logic: the AI now [b]better understands[/b] chat context and remembers previous summaries.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various UI bugs.[/p][/*][/list]
